<module id="freq_divbyodd">
	<divider id="NUM_DIV" default_value="5">Odd number to divide the input clock frequency by.</divider>
	
	<input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
	<input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
	<output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
	
	<implementation>
		// TODO: Implement this module here
		reg [31:0]cnt1;
		reg [31:0]cnt2;
		
		wire clk_div1;
		wire clk_div2;
		
		assign clk_div = clk_div1 | clk_div2;
		
		always@(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)
			begin
				if(!rst_n)
					cnt1<=0;
				else if(cnt1==NUM_DIV/2-1)
					cnt1<=0;
				else
					cnt1<=cnt1+1;
			end
			
		always@(negedge clk,negedge rst_n)
			begin
				if(!rst_n)
					cnt2<=0;
				else if(cnt2==NUM_DIV/2-1)
					cnt2<=0;
				else
					cnt2<=cnt2+1;
			end
		
		always@(posedge clk,negedge rst_n)
			begin
				if(!rst_n)
					clk_div1<=0;
				else if(cnt1==NUM_DIV/2-1)
					clk_div1<=~clk_div1;
				else
					clk_div1<=clk_div1;
			end
			
		always@(negedge clk,negedge rst_n)
			begin
				if(!rst_n)
					clk_div2<=0;
				else if(cnt2==NUM_DIV/2-1)
					clk_div2<=~clk_div2;
				else
					clk_div2</implementation></module>
